 Former Illini Keaton Wagler shines in Los Angeles Clippers Debut
 Wagler finished the game with 15 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists. Published
 2 days ago on
 October 23, 2026 By
 Alex Kyi Share Tweet Keaton Wagler played to his strengths in his official regular-season debut with the Los Angeles Clippers. Wagler was the youngest player since the great LeBron James to record 15 points, 5 rebounds, and 5 assists in a regular-season debut. He shot an efficient 4-for-8 from the field and 3-for-6 from the three-point line. In the end, the Clippers dominated the Sacramento Kings 121-96. It was certainly nice to see Keaton Wagler shine in his element as he played 29 minutes off the bench and split ball-handling duties between Clippers superstar Darius Garland and veteran Kris Dunn.
 Keaton Wagler played at his own pace. He got to the rim, knocked down open shots, and continuously made the simple play. One thing that stood out was Waglers cool and calm demeanor. Whether hes scoring 46 points at Mackey Arena or playing in his NBA debut, nothing seems to faze Keaton. As the Clippers season continues, it will be interesting to see Waglers role develop. If he continues to play at this level, look for Keaton to be the leader of the Clippers second unit and the secondary ball-handler to superstar Darius Garland.
